detaileddescription.para: Sets the configuration for the internal comparator DACs.

base
is the base address of the CMPSSLITE module.
config
is the configuration of the internal DAC.
This function configures the comparator's internal DAC. The config parameter configures the DAC value load trigger event between SYSCLK and MCPWMSYNCPER i.e. the CMPSS_DACVAL_xxx value.

The CMPSS_DACVAL_xxx term can take on the following values to specify when the DAC value is loaded from its shadow register:
CMPSS_DACVAL_SYSCLK - Value register updated on system clock.
CMPSS_DACVAL_PWMSYNC - Value register updated on PWM sync.
